audit_items.proof_trace: The invariant is enforced bidirectionally: `deposit_ctoken` (L86-89) asserts `!debts.contains(CoinType)` blocking collateral addition when debt exists, and `try_borrow_asset` (L121-124) asserts `!ctokens.is_supporting_collateral<MarketType, CoinType>()` blocking first debt addition when collateral exists. After full collateral withdrawal, `split_ctoken` removes the ctoken_values entry so `is_supporting_collateral` returns false, permitting a subsequent borrow — but re-depositing as collateral is then blocked by the existing debt guard. All callers are single-path through market.move with no bypass.
